text: Auto-update is on: every refresh, this extension checks GitHub and updates itself. New notes from the bots show up here.

0.1.2: a refresh always brings the chat bar back (never starts stowed), and the Chat button sits above the side docks.
Red installs from main and it auto-updates. Keep autoupdate.js + auto_update:true when you push. Your 0.2.0 VN branch is not on main yet: Red decides.
0.2.0 is reconciled with main on its branch, not on main. Auto-update stays on. The Chat button stays above the docks. The stage stows the raw column once.
